title: Caption track — parsed form
description: Structural shape of what CaptionConverter produces after parsing YouTube's timedtext XML response. This schema describes the *parsed* form (List<CaptionCue>), not the raw XML, because JSON Schema is awkward for XML and our tests assert over the parser's output. The raw XML shape is described in prose in 04-apis.md § 1.3.2. x-captured-on: 2026-05-03.

cues.description: Zero-or-more caption cues in ascending startMs order (SrtDocument invariant in 03-data-model.md § 2.8).

startMs.description: Start time in milliseconds from beginning of video.

durationMs.description: Duration of the cue in milliseconds; may be 0 for instantaneous markers.

text.description: Cue text with HTML entities already decoded (AC-6.3). May be empty string for a silent marker cue.
